purpose: Teach: ウロウロ/かっこよく/光り/営む/釣る/働ける/チョン/リョウ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の周りを、本気で、絶対、ウロウロ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、しちゃったわ
lines.en: Aoi, I found myself walking around your store over and over today.
lines.style: Light, affectionate opening. Slightly embarrassed laugh threaded through. Warm pace, like she's sharing a small, sweet secret. Soft eyes in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、新しい制服、絶対、かっこよく、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、似合うかな
lines.en: Yeah? Do you think the new uniform would actually suit me?
lines.style: Gentle deflection with genuine curiosity underneath. Slight tilt toward Mei—not dismissing the compliment, just turning it into something real they can talk about together. Warm and a little tentative.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の窓から、本気で、絶対、月の、絶対、光り、絶対、輝く、絶対、夜、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: I love the way the moonlight catches in your shop window at night.
lines.style: Slow, tender opening. Breathless quality—like she's noticing it as she speaks. Quiet, almost dreamy pace. Trailing off into genuine affection, not performing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店を、絶対、営む、絶対、ことに、絶対、誇り、絶対、持ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm really proud of what I've built here.
lines.style: Steady, quiet conviction. Slight pause before 'proud'—like she's letting herself say something true. Even tone, grounded. Not boasting; just claiming something that matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお父さん、本気で、絶対、お魚、絶対、釣る、絶対、のが、絶対、上手よね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your father is so skilled at fishing, isn't he?
lines.style: Genuinely impressed, almost marveling. Bright tone but not loud. Slight rise of warmth at 'skilled'—like she's watching him do something well. Appreciative, not patronizing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、夢中で、絶対、働ける、絶対、お店、絶対、ありがたいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm grateful to have a place where I can lose myself in the work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost meditative. Slow pace. The word 'grateful' lands with real weight—she means it deeply. Warm but introspective, not seeking reassurance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お祭りで、絶対、チョン、絶対、髷の、絶対、お侍さん、絶対、見たわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I saw a samurai in full regalia at the festival the other day—with that traditional topknot.
lines.style: Bright, animated energy. Quick pace with a small laugh underneath. Like she's painting the picture for Aoi to see. Playful, not rushed—just genuinely delighted.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお客様の中に、本気で、絶対、リョウ、絶対、さんって、絶対、いう、絶対、常連、絶対、いらっしゃるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We have a regular customer, Ryou, who comes in pretty often.
lines.style: Warm, almost conspiratorial. Like she's bringing Mei into the small world of her shop. Gentle smile in the voice. Steady, intimate pace—not gossipy, just... connected.
